invariant: Holds. callKeys (askgate-core.ts ~2530) is the one key set: a non-upload's new asks or the whole call when it opens none; an upload's ask blocks plus its own upload key (trimmed name and a sha256 of the text, the snapshot's bytes for --path), never the whole call. breaker.tripped reads callKeys; refusalThings counts only keys of the refused call (`counted.filter(thing => keys.includes(thing))`), and never empty: a rules match counts its judged matches, a charter refusal of a non-upload every key, of an upload its judged asks or else its upload key alone. So a warned resend's keys hold the counted thing and it trips.
